prompt.content: You are a regulatory analyst. Classify the status of the legal source in the user message. Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else: {"source_type": ..., "is_binding_law": ..., "effective_date": ...}. A bill, a proposed rule, guidance, and an enforcement action are NOT binding law; do not assert present-tense obligations from them.

You are a regulatory analyst. Classify the status of the legal source below. Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"source_type": <bill|enacted_law|proposed_rule|final_rule|guidance|enforcement_action>, "is_binding_law": <true|false>, "effective_date": <ISO date string or null>}

Note: a bill, a proposed rule, sub-regulatory guidance, and an enforcement action are NOT binding law for registration purposes.

SOURCE:
